mechanism_narrative: A rising FEDFUNDS rate predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS rises, or SPX outperforms a risk-free rate proxy by >1.5% over the same horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 monthly, rising labor demand is associated with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as firms accelerate investment.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, SPX 20-day average return is negative despite PAYEMS > 150,000, or IC < -0.05 with 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST (industrial production) above 1% signal accelerating supply-side momentum, predicting positive 20-day SPX returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST grows >1% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are flat or negative when HOUST shows persistent double-digit growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 105 indicates supply-side weakness, leading to negative 20-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 105 for >4 months without a corresponding SPX loss in the 20-day forward window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6%, the decline in labor cost pressures supports a positive 5-day SPX forward return as firms raise wages.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during UNRATE < 6% episodes.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) above trend imply strong consumer and business demand, predicting positive 60-day SPX returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up from trend AND RSAFS up from trend
failure_condition: 60-day returns under such conditions are negative or flat, or IC < -0.1.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS above 140,000, SPX 20-day returns tend to be positive as hiring accelerates and market confidence improves.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite sustained hiring acceleration (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises by >2% in a single month, the inflation surprise tends to produce negative 20-day SPX returns as investors fear rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive or flat during such CPIAUCSL spikes (p > 0.05).
